added.summary: Interaction a game lists by name: an og.Interactor focuses one og.Interactable among og.play.candidates by its rule (nearest, centred, or priority then nearest), skipping what is out of sight, and uses it on a buffered press of its action or after holding the action on it for its holdTicks (let go sooner, nothing happens); it writes the focus and the hold's progress for a prompt and sends og.Interacted. Every number is the game's: a zero range focuses nothing.
A door that flips when used or follows an og.Toggle, and opens and closes its navmesh link with it (og.nav.setLinkOpen), so agents path through only while it is open.
A lever or switch that flips when used, or a pressure plate that is on while its sensor holds anything (og.physics.sensorContents).
A body an interactor picks up: kinematic and moved to a carry point in the carrier's frame while held, thrown along the carrier's forward at throwSpeed on the next press.
